name: FUGO SHARE TO SCREEN
description:
Fugo is a digital signage platform for the screens in your offices, stores, restaurants, and factories. This connector lets Claude work directly in your Fugo workspace — so you can check what's playing where, assemble playlists, and publish to screens conversationally instead of clicking through the CMS.

 What you can do with it:

 - Screens — list every screen with its online status, location, and grouping; inspect a single display or a whole site
 - Playlists — create playlists, publish them to chosen screens, and unpublish them when a campaign ends
 - Content and media — browse your media library and folders, and add new media from a URL
 - Publishing — push content to a screen or stop playback on it, including virtual screens you can open in a browser
 - Dashboards and triggers — surface connected BI dashboards and fire manual triggers for data-driven content switching
 - Spaces — work across the Spaces your account can access, or tenant-wide from the Admin Space

 Things people ask it:

 - "Which screens have been offline more than a day?"
 - "Build a playlist from the new product shots and publish it to the Manchester lobby."
 - "What's playing in the Portland store right now?"
 - "Stop the summer campaign on every screen in the retail group."

_published_faq.name: How do I add FUGO SHARE TO SCREEN to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add FUGO SHARE TO SCREEN to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.fugo.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the FUGO SHARE TO SCREEN MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: FUGO SHARE TO SCREEN lists 28 MCP tools, including create_manual_trigger, create_playlist, create_space, delete_playlist, delete_space, get_content, get_dashboard, get_media, get_playlist, get_screen, list_content, and list_dashboards.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to FUGO SHARE TO SCREEN?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to FUGO SHARE TO SCREEN in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.

_published_faq.name: Does FUGO SHARE TO SCREEN MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: FUGO SHARE TO SCREEN requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops FUGO SHARE TO SCREEN?

acceptedAnswer.text: FUGO SHARE TO SCREEN is developed by FUGO AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
